summary: Tested the fixed driver QR/code and the downloadable business card in the Emisora section, backend and frontend. Everything passed. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests passed (new test_driver_business_card.py 5, test_rides.py, test_password_reset.py). POST /api/rides/driver/qr returns the same token and code on repeated calls. /qr/rotate returns 404/405. card.png returns 200 image/png, 1004x650, with Content-Disposition tarjeta-taxi.png, and is 401/403 without auth. OpenCV decoded the QR as https://www.asdelvolante.es/?cliente_qr=<token>, which matches the API url. Visual check: the card shows the name 'Admin Total', 'Tel. +34611000999', the code '6 3 7 5 7 6' and the site name. Client authentication with the fixed code returns 200, a wrong code returns 400, and the code stays the same after use. Frontend (mobile 390x844): logged in via 'Soy taxista' as admin/admin, then Reservas -> QR clientes. The modal shows code 637576, the rotate button and the 'Generar nuevo código' text are absent, the 'Descargar tarjeta de visita' button triggers a download named tarjeta-taxi.png (37109 bytes, valid PNG), the hint 'El QR y el código son fijos' is visible, and closing and reopening the modal shows the same code.

issues: Hint text and URL use #64748B on #0F172A (contrast about 3.7:1, 10-11px font). Consider #94A3B8 for readability.

action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: it still documents 'POST /api/rides/driver/qr/rotate', which was removed.
Optional: improve contrast of the hint text in the QR modal.
critical_code_review_comments: The fixed 6-digit code is now printed on cards, so anyone holding a card can register as that driver's client. This is by design, but there is no rate limiting on /client/authenticate.
card.png returns 500 if FRONTEND_PUBLIC_URL is unset. Acceptable, and it is set in .env.
The native (non-web) download path only shows a notify message. Acceptable for now.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Card client records via /client/authenticate with random +3469 phones
